evidence_text: A product-launch discussion promoted spreadsheet automation and was historically classified as seller launch content.
A buyer-oriented web result described manual data-entry pain affecting an operational workflow.
A routed community result was a disconfirming observation despite containing pain language.
A community post mentioned pain around an AI tool but originated from a seller launch and was not accepted as buyer evidence.
A technical issue discussed automation and manual workflow terms but only as competitive or implementation context.
A developer community issue described a manual DevOps workflow pain.
A generic web result used pain and automation language but did not establish a concrete independent buyer problem.
A second independent buyer-oriented result described recurring manual data-entry pain.
A generic web search result discussed integrations but had no buyer voice and was reduced to competition context.
A technical community record associated manual spreadsheet work with a contractor-oriented paid signal.
A community issue expressed interest in a generic AI technology category but the problem definition was not concrete.
A community issue said a user was looking for ecommerce tooling for an operational need.
